newsitem.title: USA: Dow slips as bonds weaken from highs, Nasdaq off.
newsitem.headline: Dow slips as bonds weaken from highs, Nasdaq off.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average drifted lower again on Wednesday, after making a timid stab at positive ground at around midday when the long bond yield dropped back to seven percent.
As bonds eased, and the yield on the benchmark 30-year Treasury bond went to 7.01 percent ahead of key auction results from the U.S. Treasury, the Dow retraced ground.
The Dow was trading off 23 points at around 7360, while Nasdaq, up for most of the morning, dipped 0.42 point to 1409. The long bond was up 8/32 at 7.01 percent yield, below session highs.
